title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap More info on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig into it.

items.headline_md: A **Houthi drone** hits a tower in **Riyadh's financial district**, injuring **11**; Saudi defenses down **4 more drones** over Ras Tanura
items.summary_md: The Saudi-led coalition blamed the Houthis and vowed a firm response; no injuries from Wednesday's interceptions.

items.headline_md: Update: Iran's IRGC Navy says **two more tankers** hit mines and caught fire in the **Strait of Hormuz**
items.summary_md: Iran says the ships took an "unauthorized route"; the claim comes from Iranian state media and hasn't been independently verified.

items.headline_md: **Putin** says retaliation is **"inevitable"** after Ukrainian drones hit the **Syzran and Kuibyshev** refineries
items.summary_md: Ukraine also claimed a drone attack on a Russian cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland.

items.headline_md: The FAA issued a **ground stop at Chicago O'Hare** after an equipment outage
items.summary_md: Flights were halted as a precaution, per Anadolu's briefing.

items.headline_md: **CAS reinstates Senegal** as 2025 Africa Cup of Nations champions, overturning CAF's award to Morocco
items.summary_md: Senegal's 1-0 win in the Jan. 18 final in Rabat stands.

items.headline_md: The Trump administration is set to unveil **new tariffs** on **16 trading partners**, including China and the EU
items.summary_md: Reuters says findings of an industrial overcapacity probe are due imminently, with duties on a wide range of goods expected.

items.headline_md: **Sanofi** agrees to buy **Insmed** for **$41B** ($175/share cash), pharma's biggest deal in three years
items.summary_md: Insmed closed up 14.1% Tuesday; the deal is expected to close in the first half of 2027.

items.headline_md: **Dell**'s AI server revenue hit **$22B** in Q3, but its PC business missed and shares fell
items.summary_md: Dell also raised next year's AI server forecast.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic** shares fall **below their $83 IPO price** in the tech sell-off
items.summary_md: The stock opened at $111.50 in last week's debut; it fell 6.5% Tuesday.

items.headline_md: US **consumer confidence** rose more than expected in November, to its **highest in nearly two years**
items.summary_md: Reported alongside Tuesday's market wrap.

sections.title: Games & mobile
sections.body_md: No notable hyper-casual or mobile game news in the last 24 hours.

items.headline_md: **Nioh 3** and its Complete Edition come to **Xbox Series X|S on Jan. 28, 2027**
items.summary_md: It's the series' first Xbox release; the Bloody Insurrection DLC is part of the Complete Edition.

items.headline_md: **Lords of the Fallen II** slips to **April 2027**, with an exact date promised in December
items.summary_md: CI Games gave no reason for the second delay.

items.headline_md: Capcom will shut down **Exoprimal** on **Sept. 29, 2027**
items.summary_md: The game and its DLC will be delisted on March 30, 2027.

items.headline_md: **CD Projekt** signs a **PlayStation marketing deal** for **The Witcher 4**
items.summary_md: Terms weren't disclosed; 513 people were working on The Witcher 4 at the end of October.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: Wii U lifter watch: still not public. u/Mindstormman's GitHub has 0 public repos, and the other Wii U recompilers ([CafeRecomp](https://github.com/hardkiller2565123123/CafeRecomp), [RebrewU](https://github.com/apfelteesaft/RebrewU)) still have no releases (last pushed Oct 18).

items.headline_md: GTA VI: **Take-Two DMCA'd the Leonida** PC recomp project and **2,900+ forks**; no playable PC port yet
items.summary_md: Leonida targeted a leaked Xbox build; VIctory-based forks are now leading, and r/decomps has banned GTA VI repo links.

items.headline_md: PS5: **AstroHybrid v1.2.22**, the native PC port of **Astro Bot**, fixes dual-GPU laptop hangs
items.summary_md: It also adds an RTX 30 frame-generation override.

items.headline_md: New builds: **RPCS3 v0.0.43**, **Xenia v1.0.2844**, **Vita3K v0.2.1** and a new **KytyPS5** build
items.summary_md: Emu-France's daily Git roundup, Nov 25.

items.headline_md: **Open Raven**, a recomp of the arcade **Halo: Fireteam Raven**, is posted on r/decomps
items.summary_md: An announcement-tagged post links the project's GitHub.

items.headline_md: **Red Two v1.3**, the **Rogue Leader** static recomp, adds native **Apple Silicon** builds and V-Sync
items.summary_md: It also smooths stick aiming.

items.headline_md: **Sunrise on the Reaping** set a franchise **Tuesday record** of about **$16M**, for **$148.2M** after five days
items.summary_md: Deadline expects at least $70M from Wednesday through Sunday.

items.headline_md: Update: **Focker-in-Law** now looks like about **$45M** over five days at 3,350 theaters, despite **28%** on RT
items.summary_md: That's down from earlier ~$56M five-day tracking.

items.headline_md: Disney's **Hexed** is pegged at **$75M–$80M worldwide** in its Thanksgiving opening
items.summary_md: That beats Focker-in-Law's ~$70M global projection.

items.headline_md: Netflix's **The Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth** (Fincher, Pitt) opens today in **250** theaters for two weeks, **82%** on RT
items.summary_md: It takes some IMAX screens and is expected to make single digits over five days.

items.headline_md: **Anthropic** puts **Skills over MCP** in public beta and makes background Tasks and Elicitation generally available
items.summary_md: File uploads to MCP servers are coming soon.

items.headline_md: State AGs, led by California's, ask a bankruptcy court to **block the sale of Character.AI**, including users' private chats
items.summary_md: The auction is set for Dec. 1, 2026.

items.headline_md: An **AI-assisted cyberattack** leaked names and emails of **EU Academy** users
items.summary_md: The Commission took the platform offline while it investigates the scale.

items.headline_md: **Baidu** releases open weights for **ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview**, a 280B-parameter MoE with a 1M-token context
items.summary_md: It's under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

items.headline_md: **Marlowe** raises **$277M** in seed funding for AI inference infrastructure
items.summary_md: Per AI.info's daily roundup.

items.headline_md: App stores: **South Korea** orders **Google and Apple** to fix in-app payment and app review policies **by February**
items.summary_md: The plans are due within a month and the fixes within three months.

items.headline_md: **Tidal** will reject and remove **fully AI-generated music** starting **Dec. 9**
items.summary_md: It says 43% of tracks delivered in the past three months were AI-made; AI-assisted music can stay.

items.headline_md: A US jury convicts **Huawei** on **10 of 12 counts**, including fraud and trade-secret theft
items.summary_md: Huawei will appeal; sentencing is set for September 2027.

items.headline_md: **Uber and Nuro**'s **Lucid robotaxis** are testing with **no safety driver** in four Bay Area cities
items.summary_md: Paid rides are expected early next year, later than first planned.

items.headline_md: Update: **Meta** brings its **Muse** assistant into **Instagram DMs**
items.summary_md: Users link their accounts, and Meta says Muse won't act without permission.
Tech is leading the drop ahead of today's PCE inflation data.
Nvidia is extending Tuesday's 5.9% drop, and Dell is falling after earnings.
Front-month futures.

items.headline_md: Crypto at 5:05 AM CT: **Bitcoin $58,791 (−1.6%)**, **Ether $1,645.71 (−2.3%)** over 24 hours
items.summary_md: Per CoinGecko.

items.headline_md: Overseas: MSCI's world index is **−0.4%** and Asia ex-Japan **−3.2%**; Europe is **+0.5%**
items.summary_md: The dollar is firmer on tariff talk.

items.headline_md: **PCE** data is out today; markets are **closed Thursday** and close early **Friday**
items.summary_md: Traders price a 98% chance of a 25-bp Fed hike in December.

items.headline_md: ⚠️ **Winter Storm Warning**, **noon today to 6 PM Thursday CT**, for St. Peters and Berkeley: **3–9 in.** of heavy, wet snow
items.summary_md: The heaviest snow (1–2 in./hour) falls from sunset tonight to sunrise Thanksgiving; a narrow band could top 1 ft. Expect slick roads and bridges and possible power outages from snow-loaded trees.

items.headline_md: **St. Peters**: rain and snow after noon, high near **39°**, tonight's low around **31°**; **90%** today, **4–6 in.** tonight, plus **1–2 in.** Thursday
items.summary_md: North wind, gusts to 26 mph Thursday.

items.headline_md: **Berkeley**: rain and snow after noon, high near **39°**, tonight's low around **32°**; **90%** today, **2–4 in.** tonight, about **1 in.** Thursday
items.summary_md: Little or no accumulation before this evening.

items.summary_md: WIRED's rundown of his apology, daily therapy and Trump denial explains why Nvidia, the market's AI bellwether, is still sliding.
